TITLE: Home · Haritia National Portal

PAGE TEXT:
Home · Haritia National Portal Government of the Republic of Haritia Accounts Home Services Accounts Sign in Haritia National Portal All government services in one place. Search National Identity Services Passport Services Birth and Death Registration Land Services Electricity Billing Examination Results Driving Licence Revenue and Taxation Pilgrimage Management Health Services Police Clearance Trade Licence Pension and Welfare Government services, delivered online Track applications, pay bills and fees, look up records and book appointments — from one national portal. Browse all services Citizen sign-in Sign in with your citizen id to use the online service panels. Sign in to your account Services 13 Offices 585 Notices 84 Fee entries 81 Service sectors Every sector of government service, one directory. Identity and civil records National Identity Services Birth and Death Registration Passport Services Land and utilities Land Services Electricity Billing Education, health and pilgrimage Examination Results Health Services Pilgrimage Management Tax, licensing and police Revenue and Taxation Driving Licence Police Clearance Trade Licence Pension and Welfare All services National Identity Services Apply for an identity card, correct your recorded details, register as a voter, and download a copy of your card. Passport Services Apply for a passport, book an enrolment appointment, and track an application to delivery. Birth and Death Registration Register a birth or a death, obtain a certificate, correct an entry, and check the status of an application. Land Services Search land records, apply for a mutation, pay development tax, and obtain a certified copy of a khatian. Electricity Billing Pay an electricity bill, check an outstanding amount, recharge a prepaid meter, and review your billing history. Examination Results Look up a secondary or higher-secondary result, apply for rescrutiny, and request certificates and transcripts. Driving Licence Check a licence application, generate and pay a fee challan, and book a driving test. Revenue and Taxation Register as a taxpayer, verify a taxpayer identification number, and file an individual return. Pilgrimage Management Pre-register for the annual pilgrimage, check your serial position, and see package costs and offices. Health Services Download a vaccination certificate, verify a certificate, register for vaccination and book a booster dose. Police Clearance Apply for a police clearance certificate, track an application, and register a tenant or report lost property. Trade Licence Apply for and renew a trade licence, check a licence, and see the fee schedule for each trade category. Pension and Welfare Check a pension payment, see the schemes register, find a disbursement office and apply for welfare benefits.
